ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Governing instruments: (1) International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009 and the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2018; (2) Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022 (Samoa), which repealed and replaced the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; (3) International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2018 — establishes the restricted, non-public beneficial ownership register for International Companies; (4) Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2018 — parallel UBO regime for domestic companies; (5) International Companies (Fees) Regulations (as amended); (6) AML/CFT regulations and compliance guidelines issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), operating within the Central Bank of Samoa. Under these instruments, every International Company must maintain a beneficial ownership register and file UBO particulars with the Registrar of International Companies; access is limited to the Registrar, the FIU, the Samoa International Finance Authority, and other designated competent authorities.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List (UNSC Resolutions 1267/1988, 1373, 2231 and successor designations); (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) List, applied to all USD SWIFT-TT and wire-transfer payment corridors; (iii) Samoa domestic asset-freezing designations advised by Cabinet and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade; (iv) the Samoa FIU's politically exposed persons (PEP) database and internal standards covering foreign and domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates; and (v) adverse-media and enforcement-history databases required by the registered agent's AML/CFT compliance programme under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022. For this engagement's Low_Risk_Standard wholesale matcha-powder distribution profile, a standard customer due diligence (CDD) file with enhanced due diligence escalation on any hit is required; positive PEP/sanctions hits require the registered agent's compliance officer approval and, where applicable, a suspicious transaction report to the Samoa FIU.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.commercial_substance_and_banking_risk_ti: Matches the metadata banking_aml_risk_tier of Low_Risk_Standard for ISIC 4631 wholesale procurement and distribution; target payment rails (SWIFT_TT, Wire_Transfer) require pre-funded bank references but do not alter the non-licensed corporate form.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: International Companies Registry of Samoa, operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — online name search and reservation portal accessible at www.mcil.gov.ws (Registrar of International Companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in the Latin (Roman) alphabet. Gagana Samoa (Samoan-language) names are permitted; any name in a non-English language must be transliterated into Latin characters and, if required by the Registrar, accompanied by a notarized English translation. Under the International Companies Act 1987, every International Company's name must end in a corporate designator: 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', 'Corporation', or 'Corp.' A trading name in CJK or other non-Latin script may be used only as an unofficial translation and cannot serve as the statutory registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (prior Central Bank of Samoa license and ministerial consent required)
Insurance / Assurance / Reinsurance (prior Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) license required)
Trust / Trustee (prior trust license and Registrar consent required)
Crown / Royal / Government / State / Ministry (words suggesting royal or Samoan Government patronage prohibited by the International Companies Act 1987)
Samoa / Samoan (requires demonstration of Government-linked purpose and Registrar approval when implying official connection)
University / Academy (requires Ministry of Education, Sports and Culture consent)
Chamber of Commerce / Stock Exchange (requires sector regulator approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name clearance is submitted through a licensed Samoa registered agent. The Registrar of International Companies issues the decision within 1-3 business days. On rejection, the registered agent may, within 14 days of the refusal notice, lodge a written administrative application for reconsideration with the Registrar, attaching amended name options and supporting justifications. If the Registrar affirms the refusal, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa under the Judicature Ordinance 1961 and the general administrative-law principles of natural justice. A successful reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days upon payment of the statutory extension fee, provided no earlier conflicting reservation has been filed; failure to incorporate before expiry forfeits the reservation and requires a fresh application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa situated at the premises of its licensed registered agent, and must at all times retain a licensed registered agent (International Companies Act 1987). A virtual or mail-forwarding address may be used solely for operational correspondence outside Samoa and cannot satisfy the statutory requirement; the company's trading and procurement back office may be located offshore.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the assigned banking_aml_risk_tier of Low_Risk_Standard. The annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Registrar, the Samoa International Finance Authority, or the Samoa FIU is estimated at approximately 5%, based on the entity's non-licensed wholesale-goods profile and risk-based supervision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022. Unannounced visits are materially more frequent for financial, trust, and nominee-service licensees; a compliant CDD file minimizes the practical inspection risk for this International Company.

incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association; issuance of Certificate of Incorporation under s. 7 of the International Companies Act 2012
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Samoa International Company; shares may be denominated in any currency and issued at no par value; no escrow, capital deposit, or paid-up capital verification account is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) THAT the incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act 2012 and its Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed be ratified and confirmed; (2) THAT the allotment of one million ordinary shares at no par value to the sole subscriber be approved and duly recorded in the register of members; (3) THAT the registered office situated at [address], Apia, Samoa, and [registered agent] as registered agent be adopted; (4) THAT [director] be appointed as sole Director and [secretary] as Corporate Secretary, each consenting to act; (5) THAT the common seal be adopted; and (6) THAT the authorized signatories for corporate bank accounts and trade documentation be as designated by the Director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance application to verify the proposed company name does not conflict with existing registered entities or protected statutory names. A reservation is granted for a renewable 90-day period. The name must include a restricted word such as 'Limited' or 'Corporation'; names suggesting governmental patronage are prohibited.
required_dossiers: Copy of identity document of applicant or licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of similarity or undesirability, file an alternative name application or submit a written objection response with supporting goodwill evidence within 14 days of refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Notary Public (Samoa) or foreign notary with apostille certification; incorporator executes concurrently
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the First Schedule of the International Companies Act 2012. The documents must be executed by the sole subscriber or incorporator, witnessed, and notarized. Where executed outside Samoa, the notarial act must be legalized by apostille under the Hague Convention to be accepted by the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Consent of first Director to act
Copy of passport or national ID of subscriber and Director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is challenged for defective witnessing, re-execute the affected pages and re-submit with a corrected statutory declaration from the notary confirming authenticity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia (counter and online filing portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 - Application for Incorporation together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles, and pay the government incorporation fee of USD 200 (or equivalent in Tala). Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique company number and effective incorporation date. Standard processing is three working days; expedited same-day service is available.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Evidence of payment of incorporation fee
Identity and address verification documents for beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a query, rectify the stated defect and file an amended application or supplemental declaration within 21 days; failure to cure results in deemed withdrawal, after which a fresh application with additional fee is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent approved by the Registrar of International Companies, MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a MCIL-licensed registered agent and execute a registered office agreement. The registered office must be a physical address in Apia, Samoa. The agent files the notice of appointment and maintains the statutory records, including the register of members and charges, at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent withdraws consent, the Company has 30 days to appoint a substitute licensed agent; failure to do so may lead to striking off. File an agent change notice promptly with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Setup and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors in consultation with the registered agent; consequential filings with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass unanimous written resolutions adopting the pre-formulated first board resolution. Issue share certificates, open the corporate bank account, adopt the common seal, and establish the statutory registers (members, directors, charges, and minutes). File any change of particulars (e.g., director address) with the Registrar within the prescribed period.
required_dossiers: Minutes of First Board Meeting or written resolutions
Consents to act as Directors and Secretary
Bank account opening pack (corporate resolution, KYC forms)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects a post-incorporation filing due to inconsistent particulars, submit a corrective notice and a statutory declaration from the Director confirming the accurate particulars within 14 days to avoid penalty.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Ministry for Revenue (MfR; Matagaluega o Tupe Maua a Samoa), Apia, Samoa. Sole national tax and customs authority administering the Tax Administration Act 2011, the VAGST Act 1994 and the Customs Act 2014. Online portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws; e-filing at https://efiler.revenue.gov.ws; customs clearance through ASYCUDA World managed by the Samoa Customs Service.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoan International Company (IC) obtains its statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by filing MfR form TIN-01, the IC certificate of incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, certificate of good standing, registered office and registered agent particulars, and director/shareholder identification. Application is submitted at https://www.revenue.gov.ws or physically at the MfR Headquarters in Apia, with issuance typically completed within 3-5 business days for standard compliance files. The Registrar of International Companies concurrently issues the certificate of tax exemption under the International Companies Act 2016. The TIN is a mandatory prerequisite for opening bank accounts, filing VAGST returns, lodging customs declarations and claiming export zero-rating.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — The Samoa International Company is treated as an offshore tax-exempt vehicle: profits derived from business carried on outside Samoa, including cross-border procurement and distribution of organic matcha powder to non-resident buyers, are entirely outside the Samoa income tax base. Samoa corporate income tax is not imposed on foreign-source trading profit, dividends, interest, royalties or capital gains; the IC remains within the VAGST and customs net solely for import/export compliance, and only Samoa-sourced supplies would attract Samoan taxation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not provide U.S.-style check-the-box elections, tax-transparent entity elections, hybrid mismatch elections or VAGST group registration. An IC may elect to be governed by the International Companies Act 2016 rather than the Companies Act 2012, obtain a Certificate of Exemption from the Registrar of International Companies, and voluntarily register for VAGST to preserve input-credit and export zero-rating rights. Entity classification for foreign-tax purposes (e.g., Form 8832 check-the-box in the United States) is a matter of the parent jurisdiction's law and carries no Samoan filing consequence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) — a credit-invoice value added tax levied under the VAGST Act 1994 and administered by the Samoa Ministry for Revenue in tandem with the Customs Act 2014 on imports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory VAGST registration is triggered when the actual or reasonably expected total value of taxable supplies in any 12-month period exceeds WST 100,000 (approx. USD 35,000); voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. Zero-rated export supplies count toward the threshold for registration purposes. A non-resident supplier making taxable supplies to persons in Samoa is also registrable. An International Company engaged solely in offshore matcha trading should register once turnover exceeds the threshold in order to lawfully issue tax invoices, claim input credits and support 0% export treatment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, SAF-T filing or continuous controls regime applies in Samoa. VAGST returns and payments are submitted electronically via the MfR EFiler portal; customs declarations are lodged exclusively via ASYCUDA World. All invoices issued by a registered person must contain the supplier's name and TIN, VAGST registration number, date, description and tax amount. Unregistered exporters clearing goods use ordinary commercial invoices and packing lists without fiscal branding.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAGST rate applies to: (i) goods physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply, remaining outside Samoa and not subsequently returned; (ii) services physically performed outside Samoa; and (iii) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply. The matcha exporter must prove that title and risk passed outside Samoa, that the goods left Samoa within the statutory window under an approved export declaration, and that export proceeds are repatriated through the licensed banking system. The claim is evidenced in the VAGST return together with the full export documentation bundle; unsupported claims are re-assessed at 15%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Cargo Export Declaration (CED) approved through ASYCUDA World bearing the customs export reference and exit confirmation
Original commercial invoice and packing list describing organic matcha powder, net weight, unit value and HS classification (green tea matcha under HS 0902.10)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical carriage from Samoa (Apia port/airport) to the overseas destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank evidencing receipt of the export proceeds within the statutory repatriation period
Certificate of Origin issued where the foreign importer claims preferential tariff treatment (optional but recommended)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue cross-matches every zero-rated export claim against ASYCUDA export records, carrier documents, banking inflows and counterparty contracts. Where zero-rating is claimed without adequate proof, the export is recharacterized as a standard-rated domestic supply, the 15% VAGST is clawed back retrospectively, and the shortfall attracts late-payment penalty interest of 20% per annum. Fraudulent or deliberately false export documentation is subject to a 150% shortfall penalty, fines up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment under the Tax Administration Act 2011 and VAGST Act 1994; the Commissioner may also recover clawed-back input credits as a debt due, and directors of the IC bear personal liability for knowingly false claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and exercising exchange-control supervisory authority pursuant to the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1985, as amended. The Bank also administers banking-license requirements for all authorized dealers and custodian institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a managed-float exchange-rate framework with Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) intervention; it is not a freely internationally convertible offshore currency. Samoa has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, thereby permitting unrestricted current-account payments for goods, services, and trade-related transfers through authorized dealers. Capital-account transactions by resident domestic entities—including inward portfolio flows, foreign loans, and outward direct investment—are generally subject to CBS exchange-control approval or notification. A non-resident-owned International Company (WS_IC) transacting wholly in foreign-currency offshore accounts is treated as outside the domestic exchange-control perimeter for current-account trade payments and profit remittances. Dividend and profit-repatriation hurdles for WS_IC are therefore limited to bank-level source-of-funds documentation, audited or accountant-certified reserve evidence, and applicable CBS authorized-dealer reporting forms; no prior CBS consent is mandated for remittance of declared dividends where the IC holds valid tax-exemption status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident trading entities, gross export proceeds in foreign currency must be repatriated to Samoa through an authorized dealer within 180 days of the date of shipment (or such extended period as CBS permits in writing), and the proceeds are subject to a mandatory conversion requirement into WST at the prevailing onshore market rate unless an exemption certificate is obtained. International Companies holding a valid Certificate of Registration under the International Companies Act 2012 are exempt from the mandatory-surrender and conversion rules and may retain all export receipts in foreign-currency accounts for trade settlement, treasury, and disbursement purposes. Where any such foreign-currency export proceeds are subsequently converted into WST or introduced into the domestic clearing system, the conversion event is treated as a domestic foreign-exchange transaction and triggers standard CBS reporting, timing, and onboarding verification requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank South Pacific (BSP) Limited, Samoan Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for full in-country clearing and custody. Samoa does not maintain a statutory digital-only EMI or neobank licensing regime; non-bank PSPs, offshore EMIs, and digital treasury platforms cannot hold Samoan-licensed accounts, cannot clear in WST, and may not serve as the exclusive banking partner for a WS_IC. A foreign EMI may be used as a supplementary outward-payment channel for low-value supplier disbursements in foreign currency only where a licensed Samoan authorized dealer remains the primary clearing bank, and where the EMI executes settlements via a correspondent banking network acceptable to the CBS. The EMI route materially increases AML/CFT scrutiny on transaction narratives and reconciliation for trade-finance files.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director presence is not a statutory requirement for International Companies under Samoan company or banking law; however, all four licensed banks in practice mandate a live in-person or video-verified KYC interview with at least one director, the ultimate beneficial owner, or a holder of a notarized power of attorney. Remote onboarding is accepted on a risk-basis where: (a) certified copies of the IC certificate, constitution, and registers of members and directors are endorsed by a Samoan licensed legal practitioner; (b) the UBO passport and proof-of-address are verified through a live biometric or video session; and (c) the original notarized power-of-attorney and bank-specific forms are couriered to the Samoan branch before account activation. ANZ and BSP retain de facto discretion to request an in-branch interview in Apia where the beneficial-ownership chain or the trade counterparty profile triggers enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company structure with nominee directors or historical bearer-share ambiguity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Registration under the International Companies Act 2012; certified register of members and directors evidencing no bearer securities; registered-agent certificate of good standing; IC constitution; and a signed source-of-funds and source-of-wealth affidavit from the UBO

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border matcha supplier exposure to Asia-Pacific counterparties rated as enhanced-risk or FATF grey-list jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed purchase contracts and pro-forma invoices; supplier beneficial-ownership registry extract; export-country phytosanitary certificate and certificate of origin; bill of lading and customs-entry records; and a supplier due-diligence memorandum with market-benchmark pricing evidence

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection materially disproportionate to stated capital structure upon account opening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board and shareholder resolutions authorizing the equity subscription or shareholder loan; 12-month bank statement history of the remitting shareholder; UBO tax-residency certificate; and audited financial statements or accountant-certified interim accounts of the IC

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent round-number outbound disbursements to non-bank payment aggregators or opaque third-party settlement platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed distribution and agency agreements; order confirmations with itemized lot pricing; commercial invoices matched to SWIFT MT103 field-70 references; bank-verified LC or documentary-collection records; and a rolling trade-reconciliation workbook evidencing the underlying goods-clearing events

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FX hedging or treasury transactions executed without board authorization or in an unapproved derivative capacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury and hedging policy; executed ISDA Master Agreement or bank-adopted derivatives terms; CBS notification form FX-2 for onshore forwards; and monthly dealer valuation statements confirming underlying genuine trade exposure

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) from the shareholder's home bank into the WS_IC's dedicated foreign-currency account maintained at one of the licensed Samoan authorized dealers. The recommended remittance narrative in field 70 is 'Share capital contribution' or 'Direct investment equity' with corresponding CBS balance-of-payments classification 5101 (equity) or 5201 (intercompany shareholder loan). The remitting bank must provide the full legal name, registered address, and account number of the corporate shareholder; the Samoan receiving bank will require the shareholder resolution, certificate of incumbency, UBO source-of-wealth file, and confirmation that no CBS approval is required for offshore-to-offshore foreign-currency flows. Any injection that crosses the WST domestic settlement boundary or is introduced in local currency triggers the standard inflow declaration threshold and may require CBS Form FX-1 notification before booking.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements for organic matcha procurement should be executed over two primary clearing rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 for low-value and recurring purchases, using the supplier's full BIC11, structured address, and beneficiary account details, with a dated reference to the underlying commercial invoice to prevent fragmented-payment AML flags; and (b) irrevocable documentary Commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP600 for contract-size commodity shipments, advised and confirmed through a first-class Asian correspondent bank to mitigate Samoa's correspondent-latency constraints. A monthly trade-schedule workbook, standing disbursement instruction file, and LC-advising records must be maintained at the Samoan authorized dealer to evidence genuine trade flow and to support fast-track clearing decisions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/WST deliverable forward contracts executed with a licensed Samoan authorized dealer, supported by an underlying commercial trade exposure and CBS Form FX-2 notification

Offshore USD/WST or USD/JPY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) transacted through an overseas prime broker or a correspondent international bank, funded from the IC's foreign-currency treasury account without engagement of the domestic WST settlement system

USD/WST FX swaps and cross-currency swaps documented under an ISDA Master Agreement with a licensed international bank, permitted where the swap's domestic WST leg is approved or notified to CBS and is supported by genuine treasury exposure

Plain-vanilla currency options (USD put/call) and zero-cost collars traded with a licensed broker or through the authorized dealer's derivatives desk, subject to the bank's derivative-capacity assessment and the IC's board-approved hedging policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation each year; the annual return must be lodged with the Registrar within one month following the anniversary date, and the annual government renewal fee is payable by the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late lodgement attracts a surcharge of up to 10% of the annual government fee; if the annual return and renewal fee remain outstanding for six months after the anniversary, the Registrar may issue a show-cause notice and administratively strike the International Company off the register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (International Company Licence Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on or before the anniversary of incorporation each year, subject to a one-month grace period before late penalties commence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid renewal fees accrue a late penalty surcharge and cause the loss of compliance status with the Registrar; continued default for approximately six months beyond the anniversary can result in administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, lodged by the licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act 2008 (as amended) and Samoa's beneficial ownership information requirements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, concurrent with the International Company annual return on the incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be confirmed within 14 calendar days of the relevant event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or update the UBO confirmation constitutes an offence under the applicable legislation, exposing the company and the registered agent to monetary penalties; persistent non-compliance may lead to administrative strike-off proceedings by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a Samoa International Company; an independent audit is required only if the board or shareholders voluntarily resolve to appoint an auditor or if the company holds a regulated financial services licence covering banking, insurance, or trust activity
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for International Companies, or a simplified internal accounting basis sufficient to show and explain the company's transactions; no public filing of financial statements is required for a tax-exempt International Company

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Any shareholding transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and reported to the licensed registered agent, who updates the Beneficial Ownership Register maintained at the registered office; a confirmatory UBO declaration is filed annually with the Registrar through the annual return, and any change of beneficial ownership is notified within 14 calendar days of the transfer
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 1,200 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services in Samoa
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Voluntary certified audit typically USD 800 – 3,000 per engagement; nil if the statutory audit exemption is maintained

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (domestic resident companies); effective rate 0% for International Companies under s.198 International Companies Act 1987
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are exempt from all Samoa income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and any other tax or impost pursuant to s.198 of the International Companies Act 1987. A qualifying IC conducting offshore matcha procurement and distribution pays no Samoan tax on trade receipts, unless it derives income sourced within Samoa (e.g., local domestic sales or a Samoan permanent establishment), which would forfeit the exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR), filed with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; annual government fee remitted to the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government renewal fee must be paid on or before the renewal date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique IC registration number and full legal name as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter name exactly as registered; deviation causes rejection and accrual of late fees

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Samoa maintained by the licensed resident agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the non-resident beneficial owner must maintain a physical Samoan address through its agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and address of the licensed Samoan resident agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a licensed corporate services provider; the non-resident owner may not act as its own agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital, issued shares, par value, and currency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital required; nominal shares (USD 1) held by the non-resident parent are standard

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, and nationalities of all directors and the secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors permitted; at least one natural person director is mandatory

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the register of shareholders is held at the Samoan registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership details must be disclosed to the resident agent under AML rules; the agent retains the register

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of no breach of the International Companies Act 1987, the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2021, and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signed by the resident agent; false declarations expose the agent and directors to penalties and licence revocation

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or pay the annual fee: renewal fee is doubled after the renewal date; automatic strike-off after 3 months of continued default; struck-off company loses its tax exemption retroactively and directors remain liable for obligations incurred after strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Income Tax Return (Companies) - MFR Form CT-1, filed via the Ministry for Revenue (MFR) Taxpayer Online Services (TOS) portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the company's financial year-end (e.g., 30 June deadline for a 31 December balance date)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total business income derived from all sources during the tax year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: International Company: enter 0 or leave blank; offshore matcha distribution revenue is not Samoan-source income and is exempt under s.198 IC Act

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income expressly exempted under the Income Tax Act 2012 or other legislation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: state full matcha revenue as exempt income and attach a schedule referencing s.198 of the International Companies Act 1987

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses incurred in producing assessable income, excluding capital expenditure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: deductions are nil where all income is exempt; administrative convenience may allow apportioning agent fees to exempt income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable income after deductions; the base for corporate tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: enter 0; no Samoan taxable income exists for an exempt offshore trade

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax calculated at the statutory rate on Line 3
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: enter 0; the exemption extinguishes any tax assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, PAYE, and provisional tax payments applied against assessed tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: enter 0; foreign taxes on matcha trade are outside Samoa's jurisdiction and are not creditable absent a DTA claim

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance due to the Ministry for Revenue after credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: enter 0; the IC should not be registered for provisional tax and is not required to file CT-1 at all in ordinary circumstances

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: WST 100 plus WST 20 per day; late payment: 25% surcharge of tax due; evasion or false statement: shortfall penalty up to 150% of assessed tax, criminal fine up to WST 50,000, and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Tax Administration Act 2012.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Domestic statutory rate: 15% on dividends paid to non-residents under the Income Tax Act 2012. International Company distributions: 0% - dividends or capital distributions paid by a Samoa IC to non-resident shareholders are exempt from withholding tax under the s.198 IC Act exemption, provided the IC derives no Samoa-source income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains a limited DTA network (e.g., Samoa-New Zealand DTA). To invoke treaty relief, the shareholder must (1) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority; (2) submit the TRC with MFR Form TR1 (Treaty Relief Application) and a declaration of beneficial ownership to the Samoa Ministry for Revenue before the distribution date; and (3) obtain a written remission determination. For IC distributions, no treaty claim is necessary because domestic WHT is already nil.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates on payments to non-residents: interest 15%, royalties 15% (covering IP licences, technical and management fees). Treaty rates may be lower under applicable DTA articles. A Samoa IC matcha trader should ensure no Samoan payer or Samoan-source obligor exists, so no WHT is triggered on inbound royalties or intercompany interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No formal Local File or Master File monetary thresholds are prescribed in Samoa; the Income Tax Act 2012 imposes a general arm's length obligation on related-party transactions. For the tax-exempt IC, TP documentation is not tax-driven, but a simplified contemporaneous benchmark memorandum using wholesale matcha distribution comparables should be retained to evidence price setting in any MFR audit or OECD exchange of information request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2021 applies to ICs carrying on 'relevant activities', which expressly includes distribution and service centre businesses. A Samoa IC trading organic matcha must show, on an annual Economic Substance Return, that (i) core income-generating activities - procurement negotiation, inventory risk assumption, pricing decisions, and logistics co-ordination - are performed in Samoa; (ii) adequate physical premises and full-time employees (or more than one part-time employee) exist in Samoa; and (iii) operating expenditure incurred in Samoa is proportionate to distribution income. Failure to do so is a fatal compliance breach.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abusive IC Exemption Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to conduct actual domestic Samoan trading (e.g., local matcha sales or maintaining a Samoan warehouse) while continuing to rely on s.198 exemption; making a false declaration of non-Samoan-source income on the IC-AR or economic substance return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Shortfall penalty up to 150% of evaded tax; mandatory interest; criminal fine up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Tax Administration Act 2012; the Court may also order revocation of exempt status and winding up of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent who signed false declarations are jointly and severally liable for assessed tax, the 150% penalty, and costs; the Court may issue travel bans preventing departure from Samoa and restitution orders against personal assets; directors face imprisonment up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC derives matcha distribution income but maintains no office, no employees, no Samoan bank account, and no board meeting records in Samoa; the economic substance return falsely certifies substance or is not filed at all.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty up to WST 250,000 per year of non-compliance plus daily default penalties under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2021; the Registrar may strike off the IC; details are spontaneously exchanged with the ultimate parent jurisdiction under the OECD framework, triggering foreign tax audits and recharacterization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director is personally liable for the unpaid ESR penalty; directors face fines up to WST 50,000 and disqualification from acting as a director of any Samoan company for up to 5 years; after strike-off, company assets vest in the State while directors remain liable to creditors for civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering via Trade Mis-Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over- or under-invoicing matcha shipments between the Samoa IC and related wholesale buyers or suppliers; receiving Swift/TT or wire transfers without identifying the beneficial owner; structuring payments below FIU reporting thresholds to evade scrutiny; failure to maintain underlying trade documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 15 years for money laundering under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); asset forfeiture covering trade proceeds; the resident agent's licence may be revoked and the IC's bank account frozen by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised the mis-invoicing scheme are criminally liable as principals, facing the same 15-year imprisonment term, personal fines, travel bans, passport seizure, and civil restitution orders; the corporate veil is pierced where the IC was a mere instrumentality of the beneficial owner's fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Maintain Registered Agent / Registered Office
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Allowing the resident agent to resign without replacement, abandoning the Samoan registered office, using a 'virtual office' where no person accepts service of process, or failing to notify the Registrar of changes to directors, secretary, or registered office within the prescribed period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate fee doubling and automatic strike-off after 3 months; the struck-off IC's tax exemption is retrospectively removed, exposing all offshore income to 27% corporate tax plus penalties; reinstatement requires a court application and payment of all outstanding fees and taxes plus a reinstatement fee of WST 500.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for all debts and contractual obligations incurred after the company knew it lacked a registered agent; continued trading while struck off constitutes fraudulent trading, rendering directors liable for civil restitution, disqualification, and imprisonment up to 3 years.
